title: Project STRETCH
text:
Average Lats by Date




CCS vs CCLME extent
Spatial comparison of the California Current System (CCS) as defined by Kahru et al. 2018 vs California Current Large Marine Ecosystem (CCLME) boundary (see ref).
A coarse resolution buffer was applied from the North American Coast to delineate the CCS Transition (300 km) and Offshore (1000 km) boundaries.
 


Turtle-CCS Movements
Maps showing individual movement into the CCS region by group: Historic, Cohort 1, and Cohort 2 
The portion of the track during Sept-Oct is shown in red 

HistoricCohort 1 (2023)Cohort 2 (2024)















Turtle Tracks in ENP by Group
A. All tracks (Historic + STRETCH), B. Historic (2006-2008), C. STRETCH Cohort 1 (2023), D. STRETCH Cohort 2 (2024)




Cohort 2 Tracks in ENP by Individual
Individual plots for each turtle in Cohort 2 that moved east of the release location (n = 18) during Sept-Oct 2024.

Individual movements for a given turtle are shown in green. All other tracks shown in gray.

title: Project STRETCH
text:
Average zonal flow (u) is shown with current vectors for September 2006 & 2007.
Full loggerhead tracks (2005-2008) are shown in gray. September positions between 2006-2007 are shown in green. See here for a detailed figure of individual tracks.
The average position of the 18°C SST isotherm (September 2006-2007) is shown in white/purple border. The offshore extent of the CC (as defined in Kahru & Jacox, 2018) is shown in blue.
Product: Copernicus Global Total Ocean Currents (Monthly, 0.25°), processed to a 2° x 2° spatial grid.







Figure from: Briscoe et al. (2025)










Average zonal flow (u) is shown with current vectors for September (A) 2014 and (B) 2024.
Full loggerhead tracks of 4 individuals from Cohort 2 (2024) are shown in gray (Fig 4B). September positions (2024) are shown in green.
For both figures, the average position of the September 18°C SST isotherm is shown in white/purple border. The offshore extent of the CC (as defined in Kahru & Jacox, 2018) is shown in blue.
Product: Copernicus Global Total Ocean Currents (Monthly, 0.25°), processed to a 2° x 2° spatial grid.
